_doc: Ways to make each thing an edit needs. Scores 1-5 (higher is better). `requires`: all must be met; 'a|b' = either. cost: free | subscription (owner's plan quota) | credits (metered: always ask) | paid (API key). licence: own | cc | stock | ai-service | check. privacy: local | uploads. Claude ranks with `vedit route plan <need>`, mixes routes freely, logs outcomes with `vedit route log`. Personal additions: personal/routes.json or personal/extensions/*.py ROUTES.

icon.label: Claude draws an SVG icon/element
icon.how: Write SVG inline in a composition or edit/custom/<name>.svg; animate with GSAP. Best for flat/line icons, arrows, shapes, badges.

icon.label: Iconify / Lucide / Phosphor open icon sets
Logged-in web AI (Gemini, ChatGPT, Ideogram, Firefly...) on a flat background
icon.how: references/webai.md: style-consistent prompt, download, `vedit inbox pull`, remove background, vectorize if needed.

icon.label: Canva generate-image (+ remove-background)
icon.how: Canva MCP generate-image, then remove-background; export PNG.

image.label: Claude-made illustration (SVG/HTML/Canvas/shader)
image.how: Composition in edit/custom/*.html rendered as still or animation. Abstract backgrounds, diagrams, UI mockups, gradients, data art.

image.label: Google Images, Pinterest, Behance, Unsplash via the browser
image.how: references/sourcing.md: mood board first, download with provenance, flag unclear licences.

image.label: Logged-in web AI image (Gemini/Imagen, ChatGPT, Firefly, Ideogram, Leonardo, Krea, Freepik)
Gemini API image generation (free tier key)
image.how: Gemini image model through the owner's AI Studio key.

scene_clip.label: Claude-made animated scene (HTML/GSAP/Three.js/Canvas)
scene_clip.how: Full-frame composition: abstract motion, kinetic typography, UI walkthroughs, 2.5D parallax of stills, 3D product cards.

scene_clip.label: Logged-in web AI video (Gemini Veo, Runway, Kling, Luma)
scene_clip.how: Always ask first (quota/credits). Silent clips; add sound in vedit.

motion_graphic.label: Shipped or personal template
motion_graphic.how: `vedit mg templates`; personal ones from `vedit template save`.

motion_graphic.label: Custom composition written for this moment (HTML/GSAP/SVG/Canvas)
motion_graphic.how: edit/custom/<id>.html -> Overlay.mg.file. How good edits become excellent.

motion_graphic.label: Remotion (React)
motion_graphic.how: mg/remotion; licence note for companies > 3 people.

motion_graphic.label: LottieFiles animation (lottie-web)
motion_graphic.how: Download .json (Lottie Simple License / CC), play with lottie-web in a composition.

motion_graphic.label: CapCut text/animation preset (in the CapCut hand-off)
motion_graphic.how: TextItem.capcut_intro etc.; only appears in the CapCut project.

3d.label: Three.js composition (3D text, logo, particles, product card, camera moves)
3d.how: edit/custom/*.html with window.__seek(t); phase 4 adds 3D templates.

3d.label: Blender headless render
3d.how: phase 4: bpy templates; ask before installing Blender.

vfx.label: Custom Python FX (numpy/OpenCV per frame -> alpha overlay)
vfx.how: CustomFX kind=python; `vedit fx save` to reuse.

vfx.label: FFmpeg filter chain at a render hook
vfx.how: CustomFX kind=ffmpeg (glitch, grain, vignette, chromatic shift, blur, curves).

vfx.label: CapCut effect / tracking in the CapCut hand-off
vfx.how: EffectItem.capcut; tracking done by the owner in CapCut.

music.label: Owner's music library
music.how: `vedit assets search --kind music`; earshot ears can rank by description (phase 2).

music.label: Openverse / Free Music Archive / ccMixter (CC)
music.how: Check CC-BY vs NC for commercial work; attribution in credits.

music.label: YouTube Audio Library, Pixabay Music, Uppbeat (free tiers) via the browser
Suno / Udio (logged in)
music.how: Free tiers are non-commercial: flag before publishing.

sfx.label: earshot bank + kit (252 code-made sounds, measured sync)
Freesound (CC, needs login to download)
sfx.how: Check CC0 / CC-BY; never log in for the owner.

voiceover.label: The owner records it
voiceover.how: Script with the writing pass, then transcribe.

voiceover.label: Offline neural TTS (Kokoro/Piper EN; Bangla model if licence allows)

font.label: Google Fonts via the browser
font.how: Download the TTF into the project, log OFL licence.

thumbnail.label: Best frame + Claude-designed composition
thumbnail.how: `vedit thumbnail frames|make`; custom HTML for bespoke layouts.

thumbnail.label: Canva design with the owner's brand kit
thumbnail.how: Canva MCP generate-design / brand templates, export PNG.

thumbnail.label: Web AI key art + native text overlay
thumbnail.how: Generate background/subject art; set the text natively for crisp type.

color_look.label: .cube LUT (owner's or Claude-generated)
color_look.how: edit.color.lut; phase 3 exports presets as LUTs.

color_look.label: Match a reference still/look
color_look.how: Custom python FX or curves/eq derived from `vedit style analyze` stats.

research.label: Mood board from Pinterest, Behance, Dribbble, Google, YouTube
Web search for techniques and tutorials
research.how: Then rebuild natively and `vedit technique save`.

critique.label: Second opinion: Gemini watches the render (logged in)
critique.how: Ask per project: the video leaves the PC.

critique.label: Parallel critic lenses (subagents)
critique.how: Only when the owner asks for agents.
